title: "Instacart Shopping Patterns"

  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: rows
    vertical_layout: fill
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)
library(plotly)

data("instacart")

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

hourly_orders =
  instacart %>%
  distinct(order_id, order_hour_of_day) %>%
  count(order_hour_of_day, name = "orders")

department_summary =
  instacart %>%
  group_by(department) %>%
  summarise(
    products = n(),
    reorder_rate = mean(reordered, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(products))

top_departments = department_summary %>% slice_max(products, n = 12) %>%
  mutate(department = fct_reorder(department, products))

reorder_by_cart_position =
  instacart %>%
  filter(add_to_cart_order <= 20) %>%
  group_by(add_to_cart_order) %>%
  summarise(reorder_rate = mean(reordered, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

department_scatter =
  instacart %>%
  group_by(department) %>%
  summarise(
    products = n(),
    reorder_rate = mean(reordered, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

Row {data-height=55}
-------------------------------------

### Orders by Hour

```{r}
plot_ly(
  hourly_orders,
  x = ~order_hour_of_day,
  y = ~orders,
  type = "scatter",
  mode = "lines+markers",
  line = list(color = "#2C7FB8", width = 3),
  marker = list(size = 7),
  hovertemplate = "Hour: %{x}:00<br>Orders: %{y:,}<extra></extra>"
) %>%
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Hour of day", dtick = 2),
    yaxis = list(title = "Number of orders", separatethousands = TRUE),
    margin = list(b = 55, l = 65, t = 15)
  )
```

Row {data-height=45}
-------------------------------------

### Product Rows by Department

```{r}
plot_ly(
  top_departments,
  x = ~products,
  y = ~department,
  type = "bar",
  orientation = "h",
  marker = list(color = "#41AB5D"),
  hovertemplate = "%{y}<br>Product rows: %{x:,}<extra></extra>"
) %>%
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Product rows", separatethousands = TRUE),
    yaxis = list(title = "", categoryorder = "array",
                 categoryarray = levels(top_departments$department)),
    margin = list(l = 110, b = 55, t = 15)
  )
```

### Reorder Rate by Cart Position

```{r}
plot_ly(
  reorder_by_cart_position,
  x = ~add_to_cart_order,
  y = ~reorder_rate,
  type = "scatter",
  mode = "lines+markers",
  line = list(color = "#D95F0E", width = 3),
  marker = list(size = 7),
  hovertemplate = "Cart position: %{x}<br>Reorder rate: %{y:.1%}<extra></extra>"
) %>%
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Position added to cart", dtick = 2),
    yaxis = list(title = "Reorder rate", tickformat = ".0%",
                 range = c(0, 1)),
    margin = list(b = 55, l = 65, t = 15)
  )
```

Row {data-height=45}
-------------------------------------

### Department Size and Reorder Rate

```{r}
plot_ly(
  department_scatter,
  x = ~products,
  y = ~reorder_rate,
  type = "scatter",
  mode = "markers",
  color = ~department,
  size = ~products,
  sizes = c(8, 28),
  text = ~department,
  hovertemplate = paste(
    "%{text}<br>Product rows: %{x:,}",
    "<br>Reorder rate: %{y:.1%}<extra></extra>"
  ),
  showlegend = FALSE
) %>%
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Product rows", separatethousands = TRUE),
    yaxis = list(title = "Reorder rate", tickformat = ".0%"),
    margin = list(b = 55, l = 65, t = 15)
  )
```

### About this dashboard

Each row in the class Instacart dataset is a product in a user's order. The line charts summarize when orders occur and how reorder frequency changes with cart position. The bar chart compares product-row volume across the 12 largest departments, and the scatterplot compares department size with reorder rate. These data are a cleaned training subset and are not a random sample of all Instacart purchases.
